title: 常压过滤与减压过滤（国内版）
source_doc: course/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/03_Gravity Filtration and Vacuum Filtration.md
author_source: project/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/03_Gravity Filtration and Vacuum Filtration（国内版）/src.py

points.S4: 有机溶剂在通风柜里滤
points.S5: 滤液和废滤纸分类收集

shots.scene: 欣欣站在铁架台旁，手里举着一张圆形滤纸，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a ring stand holding up a round filter paper and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学常压过滤和减压过滤。

shots.scene: 漏斗、滤纸、抽滤瓶、护目镜四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a glass funnel, a folded filter paper cone, a filter flask with a side arm, and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 折得好、倒得慢、抽得稳、护得全。

shots.scene: 阿杰把一大烧杯悬浊液一下子倒进漏斗，液体漫过滤纸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours a whole beaker of cloudy suspension into a funnel at once; liquid rises above the edge of the filter paper.
shots.narration: 阿杰图快，一口气全倒进漏斗。

shots.scene: 接收瓶里的滤液变浑浊，阿杰皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The filtrate in the receiving flask turns cloudy with solid particles; the young male student frowns.
shots.narration: 结果滤液是浑的，白忙一场。

shots.scene: 小研戴着护目镜走过来，指着漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and goggles walks over and points at the funnel.
shots.narration: 小研说：过滤也有讲究，从头来。

shots.scene: 圆底烧瓶里有固体、液体和气泡
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask containing solid particles, liquid and gas bubbles together. No people.
shots.narration: 反应得到的，往往是一瓶混合物。

shots.scene: 箭头从混合物烧瓶指向一个分子图标
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a mixture flask to a single molecule icon labeled with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 要拿到目标物，就得把它分出来。

shots.scene: 固体、液体、气体三个图标，各配不同分离工具
shots.prompt_en: Three icons for solid, liquid and gas, each paired with a different separation tool icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用什么方法，看各组分的状态和性质。

shots.scene: 过滤示意：固液混合物倒入漏斗，固体留在滤纸上，液体流下
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a solid-liquid mixture poured into a funnel, solid stays on the filter paper, clear liquid drips into a flask below. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤，快速把固体和液体分开。

shots.scene: 滤网过滤的生活图标：茶叶留在滤网上，茶水流下
shots.prompt_en: An everyday icon: tea leaves caught in a strainer while tea flows into a cup below. No people.
shots.narration: 就像滤网：水过去，渣留下。

shots.scene: 两个装置图标：普通漏斗装置和抽滤装置
shots.prompt_en: Two apparatus icons side by side: a funnel on a flask, and a funnel on a filter flask with a hose. No people.
shots.narration: 常用的有常压过滤和减压过滤。

shots.scene: 向下的重力箭头和抽气泵图标
shots.prompt_en: A downward gravity arrow icon next to a vacuum pump icon. No people.
shots.narration: 名字来自推动液体的方式。

shots.scene: 重力箭头指向漏斗，液体自然滴下
shots.prompt_en: A large downward arrow above a funnel; liquid drips through by itself. No people.
shots.narration: 常压过滤，靠重力让液体流下。

shots.scene: 白色颗粒干燥剂在溶液中，被滤纸拦住
shots.prompt_en: White drying agent granules in a solution being caught by filter paper while clear liquid passes. No people.
shots.narration: 常用来滤掉杂质或干燥剂。

shots.scene: 接收瓶里清澈的滤液，旁边绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A receiving flask with clear filtrate and a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这时我们要的，是流下来的滤液。

shots.scene: 器材排开：铁架台、铁圈、玻璃漏斗、滤纸、锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: Equipment laid out on a bench: a ring stand, a ring clamp, a glass funnel, filter papers and a clean conical flask. No people.
shots.narration: 铁架台、铁圈、漏斗、滤纸、接收瓶。

shots.scene: 老周把铁圈固定好，漏斗放进去，下面放干净锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The older man in a lab coat and goggles fixes a ring clamp to a stand, sets a funnel in it and places a clean conical flask below.
shots.narration: 接收瓶要干净，流进去的叫滤液。

shots.scene: 滤纸微孔放大图：液体分子穿过，固体颗粒被挡
shots.prompt_en: A magnified view of filter paper pores: small liquid droplets pass through while larger solid particles are blocked. No people.
shots.narration: 滤纸有细孔，液体过得去，固体过不去。

shots.scene: 折错的滤纸留着开口，混合物直接漏下，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrongly folded filter paper with an open gap, mixture leaking straight through, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 折的时候绝不能留开口。

shots.scene: 圆形滤纸对折成半圆
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands folding a round filter paper in half.
shots.narration: 圆滤纸先对折。

shots.scene: 半圆再对折成四分之一圆
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands fold the half circle in half again into a quarter circle.
shots.narration: 再对折一次。

shots.scene: 打开一层成圆锥，放入漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands open one layer to form a cone and set it into a glass funnel.
shots.narration: 打开一层成圆锥，正好放进漏斗。

shots.scene: 扇形褶皱滤纸特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a fluted filter paper folded like a fan with many pleats. No people.
shots.narration: 进阶折法：折成扇形褶皱。

shots.scene: 扇形滤纸放在漏斗里，液体快速流下，旁边速度箭头
shots.prompt_en: A fluted filter paper in a funnel with liquid flowing quickly, a speed arrow icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤面积大了，流得更快。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，旁边四折滤纸图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside a simple cone filter paper icon.
shots.narration: 初学的话，四折法就够用。

shots.scene: 滤纸在漏斗里翘起，没贴紧
shots.prompt_en: A filter paper cone sitting loosely in a funnel, its edge lifting away from the glass. No people.
shots.narration: 滤纸贴不住漏斗怎么办？

shots.scene: 小研用洗瓶把滤纸均匀润湿
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles wets the filter paper evenly with a squeeze wash bottle.
shots.narration: 用和混合物相同的溶剂润湿它。

shots.scene: 贴紧的滤纸，有气泡的地方被圈出打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a filter paper with trapped air bubbles crossed out with a red X, and a smooth fully wetted paper with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 均匀润湿，不留干斑和气泡。

shots.scene: 小研轻轻摇动烧杯，固体悬浮起来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently swirls a beaker so that the solid is suspended in the liquid.
shots.narration: 先摇匀，让固体悬浮起来。

shots.scene: 小研沿玻璃棒把悬浊液慢慢倒入漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly pours the suspension down a glass rod into the funnel.
shots.narration: 再沿玻璃棒缓缓倒入。

shots.scene: 接收瓶里出现固体颗粒，旁边重来箭头
shots.prompt_en: A receiving flask with solid particles in the filtrate, and a circular redo arrow icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 滤液里见到固体，换个干净瓶重滤。

shots.scene: 漏斗液面在滤纸上沿以下，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A funnel with the liquid level well below the top edge of the filter paper, green check. No people.
shots.narration: 等液面降下去，再接着倒。

shots.scene: 液面漫过滤纸边缘，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: A funnel where liquid overflows above the filter paper edge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 漫过滤纸，没滤的就直接流下去了。

shots.scene: 原烧杯壁上残留白色固体
shots.prompt_en: White solid residue clinging to the bottom and walls of an emptied beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 烧杯里还粘着一些固体。

shots.scene: 小研用洗瓶冲洗烧杯，倒入漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses the beaker with a wash bottle and pours the rinse into the funnel.
shots.narration: 用合适溶剂冲一冲，一起倒进去。

shots.scene: 漏斗下端不再滴液，旁边绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A funnel tip with no more drops falling and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不再滴液，过滤就完成了。

shots.scene: 大桶悬浊液旁的漏斗，旁边慢慢转的钟表
shots.prompt_en: A small funnel next to a huge beaker of suspension, with a clock icon showing a long wait. No people.
shots.narration: 量少滤得快，常压过滤就行。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着抽滤装置
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a vacuum filtration setup on a stand.
shots.narration: 量大太慢，就换减压过滤。

shots.scene: 抽滤装置剖面：真空泵抽走瓶内空气，箭头向外
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a filter flask with air arrows being drawn out through the side arm to a pump. No people.
shots.narration: 真空泵把瓶里的空气抽走。

shots.scene: 大气压箭头从上往下压在漏斗液面上
shots.prompt_en: Big atmospheric pressure arrows pressing down on the liquid in the funnel, liquid rushing through. No people.
shots.narration: 外面的大气压，把液体快速压下去。

shots.scene: 厚壁抽滤瓶，侧管箭头标出
shots.prompt_en: A thick-walled filter flask with its side arm highlighted by an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 要用带侧管的抽滤瓶。

shots.scene: 橡胶管连接侧管和台面上的真空接口
shots.prompt_en: A thick rubber vacuum hose connecting the side arm of a filter flask to a vacuum outlet on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 厚壁橡胶管接实验台真空口或真空泵。

shots.scene: 布氏漏斗插在橡胶塞里
shots.prompt_en: A white ceramic Buchner funnel fitted into a rubber stopper. No people.
shots.narration: 布氏漏斗配橡胶塞，才能密封。

shots.scene: 滤纸平铺在布氏漏斗底部，盖住所有小孔
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a Buchner funnel with a round filter paper lying flat, covering all the holes without touching the walls. No people.
shots.narration: 滤纸要盖住所有小孔，又不碰内壁。

shots.scene: 小研用剪刀修剪过大的滤纸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student trims an oversized filter paper with scissors.
shots.narration: 滤纸太大，就剪小一点。

shots.scene: 露出小孔的滤纸图标，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a filter paper too small, leaving holes exposed at the edge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 露出一个孔，混合物就会漏下去。

shots.scene: 老周把抽滤瓶夹紧在铁架台上
shots.prompt_en: The older man clamps a filter flask tightly to a ring stand.
shots.narration: 第一步，把抽滤瓶夹紧防倒。

shots.scene: 老周接上真空管，装上布氏漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The older man attaches the vacuum hose to the side arm and seats the Buchner funnel firmly on top.
shots.narration: 接真空管，装漏斗，确保密封。

shots.scene: 老周放滤纸并用洗瓶润湿
shots.prompt_en: The older man places the filter paper in the funnel and wets it with a wash bottle.
shots.narration: 放好滤纸，用溶剂润湿。

shots.scene: 手慢慢拧开真空阀
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand slowly turns open a vacuum valve on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 先慢慢打开真空。

shots.scene: 滤纸紧紧吸在漏斗底部，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The filter paper is pulled tightly against the bottom of the funnel, green check. No people.
shots.narration: 滤纸吸紧了，说明工作正常。

shots.scene: 放大镜检查接口处，漏气图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over the joint between the hose and side arm, with small leak lines. No people.
shots.narration: 吸不住就是漏气，查瓶口和管口。

shots.scene: 小研给变干的滤纸补加溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adds a little more solvent to a filter paper that has dried out.
shots.narration: 溶剂挥发快，滤纸干了就补一点。

shots.scene: 悬浊液倒进布氏漏斗，滤液快速流下
shots.prompt_en: A suspension being poured into a Buchner funnel; filtrate streams quickly into the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 倒入混合物，比常压快得多。

shots.scene: 真空旋钮调到最大、滤纸破裂的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a vacuum knob turned to maximum and a torn filter paper, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 慢了可加大真空，太大会抽破滤纸。

shots.scene: 换上干净抽滤瓶和新滤纸
shots.prompt_en: A clean filter flask and a fresh filter paper ready on the bench beside a redo arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 滤液见固体，换瓶换纸重新滤。

shots.scene: 布氏漏斗液面适中，不溢出
shots.prompt_en: A Buchner funnel with the liquid level kept moderate, not overflowing. No people.
shots.narration: 继续倒，漏斗不能溢出。

shots.scene: 滤纸翘起移位的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a filter paper lifted and shifted off the holes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 滤纸一移位，混合物就漏过去。

shots.scene: 抽滤瓶内液面接近侧管，侧管处红圈
shots.prompt_en: A filter flask with the filtrate level rising close to the side arm, the side arm circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 盯住瓶里滤液，别让它靠近侧管。

shots.scene: 液体被吸进真空管的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid being sucked from the flask into the vacuum hose, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不然会被吸进真空系统。

shots.scene: 小研关真空，把滤液倒入另一个瓶子，再接回
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns off the vacuum, pours the filtrate into another flask, then reconnects the setup.
shots.narration: 液面高了：关真空，转出滤液，再继续。

shots.scene: 滤纸上一层白色固体，真空继续运行
shots.prompt_en: A layer of white solid on the filter paper while the vacuum keeps running. No people.
shots.narration: 滤完多抽一会儿，固体更干。

shots.scene: 左边滤纸上的固体，右边瓶中的滤液
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: solid on filter paper on the left, liquid filtrate in a flask on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 固体在纸上，液体在瓶里。

shots.scene: 固体、滤液两个图标都可能打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with question marks turning into green checks: the solid cake and the filtrate. No people.
shots.narration: 要哪一个，看实验目的，或者都要。

shots.scene: 小研用药匙把干燥的固体刮到表面皿上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student scrapes a dry solid cake from the filter paper onto a watch glass with a spatula.
shots.narration: 要固体时，减压过滤更合适。

shots.scene: 表面皿上的固体，旁边干燥和分析仪器图标
shots.prompt_en: A watch glass with powder next to a drying icon and an analysis instrument icon with a blank screen. No people.
shots.narration: 干得快，好刮下，方便干燥和分析。

shots.scene: 混合物烧瓶分出原料、副产物、溶剂，目标物单独出来
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a mixture flask splitting into starting material, side products and solvent, with the target product separated out. No people.
shots.narration: 合成后都要把目标物分离出来。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一瓶纯净的白色晶体
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small vial of pure white crystals with a blank label.
shots.narration: 过滤，会一次次派上用场。

shots.scene: 小研戴好护目镜，检查手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on safety goggles and checks her nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 过滤前，护目镜和手套戴好。

shots.scene: 普通眼镜被红叉，护目镜打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: ordinary eyeglasses with a red X and wrap-around safety goggles with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 普通眼镜挡不住飞溅，要戴护目镜。

shots.scene: 不同手套和溶剂瓶配对的图标
shots.prompt_en: Several glove icons matched with solvent bottles bearing hazard pictograms and blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 手套按所用溶剂选择，破了就换。

shots.scene: 厚壁抽滤瓶打勾，薄壁锥形瓶接真空管被红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a thick-walled filter flask with a green check, and a thin-walled conical flask connected to a vacuum hose with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 抽真空只用厚壁耐压的抽滤瓶。

shots.scene: 老周对着光检查抽滤瓶有无裂纹
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a filter flask up to the light and checks it for cracks.
shots.narration: 用前检查，有裂纹、星裂的不能抽。

shots.scene: 向内塌缩的瓶子图标，旁边黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flask collapsing inward with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有伤的瓶子受压，可能向内爆裂。

shots.scene: 较大的减压装置外罩着防护网
shots.prompt_en: A larger vacuum setup inside a fume hood with a protective mesh shield around the flask and the sash lowered. No people.
shots.narration: 大装置加防护罩，按本校规定执行。

shots.scene: 抽滤瓶和真空源之间多了一个缓冲瓶
shots.prompt_en: A setup diagram: filter flask, then an empty safety trap bottle, then the vacuum source, connected by hoses. No people.
shots.narration: 抽滤瓶和真空源之间加缓冲瓶。

shots.scene: 水从真空源倒流进瓶子的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water flowing backward from a vacuum source into the filter flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防止倒吸，也保护真空泵。

shots.scene: 停机顺序：先拔管或开放气阀，再关泵
shots.prompt_en: Two step icons: first a hand pulling the hose off the side arm, then a hand switching off the pump. No people.
shots.narration: 停止时，先断开真空管，再关泵。

shots.section_title: 有机溶剂在通风柜里滤
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里做减压过滤，柜门放低
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student performs a vacuum filtration inside a fume hood with the sash lowered.
shots.narration: 滤有机溶剂，放到通风柜里做。
overlay: 有机溶剂在通风柜里滤

shots.section_title: 有机溶剂在通风柜里滤
shots.scene: 溶剂蒸气被抽向泵的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of solvent vapor being drawn from the flask toward a pump, with an exhaust arrow into a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 减压会让溶剂挥发得更快。

shots.section_title: 有机溶剂在通风柜里滤
shots.scene: 易燃溶剂瓶旁的明火被红叉
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle with a flame pictogram next to an open flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 附近不能有明火。

shots.section_title: 滤液和废滤纸分类收集
shots.scene: 滤液倒进水槽的图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of filtrate being poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 滤液别倒进水槽。
overlay: 滤液和废滤纸分类收集

shots.section_title: 滤液和废滤纸分类收集
shots.scene: 小研把滤液倒入标签空白的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours filtrate through a funnel into a waste solvent container with a blank label.
shots.narration: 按类别倒进对应的废液桶。

shots.section_title: 滤液和废滤纸分类收集
shots.scene: 沾了化学品的滤纸放进固体废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Used filter paper with chemical residue going into a solid chemical waste bin with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的滤纸放进固体化学废物桶。

shots.section_title: 滤液和废滤纸分类收集
shots.scene: 王老师查看废液登记本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank waste log sheet attached to a waste container.
shots.narration: 做好登记，按学校规定统一处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四折滤纸、玻璃棒、漏斗图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a folded filter paper, a glass rod and a funnel.
shots.narration: 常压：折好滤纸，润湿，慢慢倒。

shots.scene: 抽滤装置图标，夹子和密封处打勾
shots.prompt_en: A vacuum filtration setup icon with green checks on the clamp and the stopper seal. No people.
shots.narration: 减压：夹紧密封，慢开真空，适度抽。

shots.scene: 侧管红圈、缓冲瓶、先断开再关泵图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a side arm circled in red, a safety trap bottle, and a hose being disconnected before a pump switch. No people.
shots.narration: 盯住滤液，加缓冲瓶，先断管再关泵。

shots.scene: 护目镜、厚壁抽滤瓶、废液桶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: safety goggles, a thick-walled filter flask, and a waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 戴好护目镜，用厚壁瓶，废液分类收。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一瓶干净的白色晶体挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a vial of clean white crystals and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 过滤做得好，产物拿得到，下次见！
